task: Build a complete, production-oriented mobile UI for an India-first, platonic, peer-to-peer real-world activity network. Use the attached three-phone screenshot as the visual reference for style and composition.

product_translation.left_screen: Social Roadmap + Daily Quests: large headline, original active mascot, week strip, quest cards, XP and level progress.
product_translation.middle_screen: Discover home: greeting/avatar, city area, search, featured nearby activity card, quick category chips, activity cards, bottom navigation.
product_translation.right_screen: Plan Assistant: original animated orb/mascot, quick mood chips, text input, suggested plan creation, small roadmap progress preview. Never force AI; include a manual flow.

design_constraints: Create every screen in screen_inventory.json, including loading, empty, error, permission and safety states.
Do not copy any third-party logo, mascot, wording, icons, or branded illustration from the reference.
Design responsive layouts for common Android and iPhone sizes; avoid fixed screenshot coordinates.
Keep core discovery, plan creation, joining, messaging required for plans, blocking and reporting available to free users.
Use animation spec from motion_system.json; provide reduced-motion equivalents.
